title: huddle config
description: ~/.config/huddle/config.toml (SPEC.md §5). Top-level keys are shared settings; every other top-level table is a profile.

repo_roots.description: Folders whose subfolders are your repos, e.g. ["~/code/agency/shops", "~/code/agency/tools"]. A leading ~ is your home folder.

clickup_branch_template.description: Branch name for ClickUp tasks. {id_lower} is the task ID in lowercase, {slug} up to 5 lowercase ASCII words of the title.

clickup_prompt_template.description: Agent prompt for ClickUp tasks when the Start panel's prompt is empty. {id} is the task ID.

issue_prompt_template.description: Agent prompt for GitHub issues in a repo (checkout or worktree) when the Start panel's prompt is empty. {id} is repo#42, {full_id} owner/repo#42, {number} 42, {title} the title, {url} the issue URL. Without it: "Take an issue #{number}".

issue_scratch_prompt_template.description: Agent prompt for GitHub issues in a scratch folder (no repo there, so use {full_id} or {url}). Same values as issue_prompt_template. Without it: "Take an issue {full_id}".

scratch_task_types.description: ClickUp task types that start in a scratch folder by default.

scratch_title_prefixes.description: Title first words (any case) that make a scratch folder the default workspace.

status_in_progress.description: ClickUp status set by "Move to" on launch.

agents.description: Agent commands for the Start panel: name = argv. {prompt} is replaced by the prompt. Your own agents show after the built-in ones, sorted; a built-in name replaces its command.

repos.description: Per-repo settings, keyed by repo folder name.

base_branch.description: Base branch for new worktrees, e.g. snowcap = "develop". Without one, origin/HEAD.

propertyNames.description: Profile names: letters, digits, - and _ only.

profile.description: A profile: one named world with its sources, GitHub account, cache and state.

clickup.description: Show ClickUp tasks in this profile.

clickup_workspace.description: ClickUp workspace ID. Found automatically (the only workspace the token sees); set only to override.

clickup_lead.description: ID of the ClickUp "Lead Assignee" users field. Found automatically (the one users field with "lead" in its name); set only to override.

github_account.description: gh account whose token this profile uses (gh auth token --user NAME). Default: gh's active account.

github_orgs.description: GitHub orgs whose issues and PRs belong to this profile. Without it, the profile gets everything outside other profiles' orgs.

github_issues.description: Show GitHub issues in this profile.

repo_roots.description: Overrides the shared repo_roots for this profile.

scratch_root.description: Overrides the shared scratch_root for this profile.

clickup_prompt_template.description: Overrides the shared clickup_prompt_template for this profile.

issue_prompt_template.description: Overrides the shared issue_prompt_template for this profile.

issue_scratch_prompt_template.description: Overrides the shared issue_scratch_prompt_template for this profile.
